name: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd
about: Himadri Speciality Chemical is primarily engaged in the manufacturing of carbon materials and chemicals.[1] It is the No.1 coal pitch manufacturer in India and is the only company to manufacture advanced carbon material in India. It is also the largest player of Naphthalene and SNF in India.[2]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
The company is a key player across various product segments, including battery materials, coal tar pitch, carbon black, naphthalene, refined naphthalene, SNF, and specialty oils. It serves various industries, such as lithium-ion batteries, paints, plastics, tires, aluminum, graphite electrodes, agrochemicals, defense, and construction chemicals. [1]
